content.introduction: According to the sources, it is generally an okay time to invest in the market. Stocks tend to rise in the long term, about two out of three time periods, regardless of the time frame chosen. Long-term investing is essential for meeting financial goals, and staying invested over the long term allows investors to benefit from compounding and potentially overcome short-term setbacks. Even during periods of heightened volatility, getting invested and staying invested is a good strategy. However, it's important to note that stocks are inherently volatile and can fall for months at a time, so one must see something significant and negative that isn't priced into stocks to determine if now is a bad time to invest.
